build_transformer_model: build a Llama-style Transformer model from ModelArgs config with rotary embeddings and flash attention
create_model_args_config: create a ModelArgs dataclass to configure dim, n_layers, n_heads, vocab_size, and max_seq_len
run_transformer_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the Transformer with token indices to get output logits
apply_rotary_embeddings: apply rotary position embeddings to query and key tensors using precomputed frequency cis
precompute_frequency_cis: precompute the frequency tensor for complex exponentials used in rotary positional encoding
